about: Every artist and composer, song by song, grouped by album (an era). Tags describe how each song sounds (mood, tempo feel, instruments, production), so Semitone can pick an era, or songs whose tags match what the user asks for. Chord data lives in progressions.json under the era profile id. Tags are descriptive notes written for Semitone, not copied text; edit them freely. Covers are listed but never analysed. Emotion is the feeling; vibe is the setting or picture (see data/sound-library.json vibes).
